links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified ACR patient education materials
links.outcome: Readability (reading grade level) of patient education materials
links.effect: Mean reading level fell from 12th grade (12.02 ± 1.35) to 9.35 ± 1.12 after ChatGPT simplification; GFI 14.24 to 10.70, FKGL 11.50 to 8.29, CLI 13.31 to 10.18, SMOG 10.33 to 7.68. Simplified materials ranged from grades 7 to 13 and did not reach the 6th-grade target.
links.tradeoff: Output failed to reach the 6th-grade AMA target; the authors flag ChatGPT's inherent bias. Accuracy and completeness of the simplified text were not reported.
links.quote: The readability of ACR patient education materials exceeds AMA recommendations, and while ChatGPT significantly lowered the reading level, it failed to reach the 6th-grade level.
